SectorSpreadsheet.title: Sector Spreadsheet Mapping
SectorSpreadsheet.description: Mapping of a PEA area sector to its respective Google Spreadsheet and Google Drive assets folder.

folderId.description: The unique ID of the Google Drive folder for image uploads.

AdminNotification.title: Admin Notification
